a fuck about Judaism or any of the religions stemming from Judaism, unless they

Are you a fucking kike?  An ugly, hook-nosed, subversive, disgusting, filthy,
greedy, politically correct piece of trash?  If so, at least try demonstrated
the slightly above-average intelligence characteristic of your race, rather
than behaving like a dumb, left-wing, Jerry Springer-watching redneck.

Now, go back to your trailer park, donut-dunking punk.

Pyro
